text:
maria: Quick ask — planning a mixed k6 + Locust replay this Wednesday 02:00 PT. Need profiling coverage + a short canary (15m) before full 4h soak. Primary goals: reproduce last-night p95 spike and validate KV cache TTL behavior under interleaved traffic. Who can own collecting flamegraphs and heap/alloc profiles?

aj: I can help with the ramp/traffic shape. Do you have the k6 scenario and locust user classes ready? Also what target RPS / concurrent users?

maria: rough plan below (can tweak):

```yaml
k6: 
  duration: 30m
  stages:
    - { duration: "5m", target: 200 }
    - { duration: "20m", target: 1000 }
    - { duration: "5m", target: 0 }
locust: 
  users: 2000
  spawn_rate: 200
  run_time: 4h
canary_window: 15m
replay_sets: sanitized_prod_week1
notes: interleave bursts from k6 with steady locust sessions
```

maria: replay dataset is sanitized (tokens scrubbed) — @olivia can confirm.

olivia: confirmed, dataset uses scrub pipeline v2 and we drop headers + cookies. I'll be watching the scrub logs during run. :eyes:

noah: I can own perf collection. Plan: eBPF CPU stacks + async flamegraphs + periodic jmap heap dumps. Uploads to /uploads/perf/1898765432/ (make sure retention 7d). Should I enable allocation sampling (`--alloc-sample`) on the runtime?

maria: yes please enable allocation sampling and KV cache debug for the canary only. We'll toggle env: `REDWOOD_KV_CACHE_DEBUG=true` for the canary deployment.

sam: pinging — the potential regression I mentioned is in PR #4321 (kv-batching). If that lands before the test we should either revert or set `KV_BATCHING=off` for the canary. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/4321

aj: noted. That PR introduced a change to batching window (commit: `c4f9b2a`). If we suspect it, disable batching for the canary: `KV_BATCHING=off`. Also, can we add a tiny probe to the test to assert `x-kv-hit` headers so we can see cache effectiveness?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-redwood-runtime -> prod-like (15m) by maria at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z :rocket:

perf-bot: baseline metrics snapshot uploaded: https://graphs.internal/redwood/snapshots/bs-2026-03-17-23. Includes p50/p95/p99 for last 24h.

noah: profiler commands I'll run during canary (dropping here so infra can pre-authorize):

```bash
# eBPF sampling (run on node pool)
sudo /opt/perf-tools/ebpf-sample --pid $(pgrep redwood-runtime) --freq 99 --duration 900 --out /tmp/ebpf-1898765432.folded

# flamegraph generation (local)
stackcollapse-perf.pl /tmp/ebpf-1898765432.folded > /tmp/stack.folded
flamegraph.pl /tmp/stack.folded > /uploads/perf/1898765432/flame.html

# jmap heap dump trigger (thrift endpoint)
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/debug/jmap?dump=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIAG_TOKEN" -o /uploads/perf/1898765432/heap.hprof
```

noah: Also will enable a sampling JFR: `-XX:StartFlightRecording=name=canary,delay=0s,duration=900s,settings=profile` — confirm JVM flags allowed?

maria: yes for canary only. Infra, please allow the extra disk I/O for uploads (temp quota +10GB) during the run.

aj: infra note — bump dedicated pool concurrency by 30% for the 3h soak. Command to scale: `kubectl scale deploy redwood-runtime --replicas=13 -n redwood-prod` (current 10). I'll coordinate autoscaler cooldowns.

olivia: I'll be on watch for scrub/no-leak alerts. If anything sensitive shows up we abort. :no_entry_sign:

sam: tiny code-review ask — I left a comment on PR #4321 about a missing metric tag. If you can address quickly we can run with the patch. Link again: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/4321#discussion_r1234

maria: timeline proposal:
- 01:30 PT: infra scale + pre-warm caches
- 01:45 PT: start profiler baseline collection (5m)
- 02:00 PT: canary deploy + k6 short burst (15m)
- 02:15 PT: decision point -> full locust soak (4h)

maria: action owners: noah (perf collection), aj (ramp & scale), olivia (scrub/watch), sam (PR / quick fixes), maria (orchestration).

noah: will create a small monitoring dashboard and add alert rules: p95 > baseline * 1.35 and allocation rate spike. Link when ready.

aj: I'll add the `x-kv-hit` probe and a k6 step that hits hot keys at varying TTLs.

sam: will try to push fix for metric tag within 30m. If not, we'll flip `KV_BATCHING=off` for the canary.

maria: perfect. I'll post a quick runbook in #incidents just before start and leave the canary toggle in the console for rollback. :thumbsup:

olivia: 02:00 PT works for me. I'll join the call and handle scrub logs.

maria: thanks all — see you Wednesday 02:00 PT.
